name: K-12 AI Infrastructure Platform
summary: The K-12 AI Infrastructure Program's hub, run by DrivenData, for the datasets, benchmarks and challenges it funds or lists, each shown with its license.

license.note: Each resource has its own license, shown on its page; of the ten datasets it listed on 2026-11-03, four were non-commercial.

access_note: Its terms of use ask for a registered account to download.

fits.how: No slot: a source of datasets and benchmarks, where the Program asks its grantees to release their public goods.

connect.note: A platform that lists resources, each on its own terms, behind an account. Where a resource it lists is connected here, it has its own entry.
